subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: The Axle: Making the Wheel Useful
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Axle: Making the Wheel Useful usable.

hook.text: A wheel alone is just a disc. Add an axle and it becomes a rotary lever that multiplies force.

buildup.text: When you turn a large wheel, the axle turns with less distance but more torque. Force is amplified.

discovery.text: A doorknob is a wheel and axle. The wide knob gives your hand leverage to turn a small latch bolt.

twist.text: Reverse it and you trade force for speed. A bicycle axle turns a small gear that spins a big wheel fast.

climax.text: Steering wheels, winches, and screwdrivers all use the wheel-and-axle principle daily.

punchline.text: The axle turns a circle into a force multiplier.

quiz.question: How does a wheel-and-axle system amplify force?
options: The axle spins faster than the wheel, generating extra energy
Turning the larger wheel produces greater torque at the smaller axle
Friction between wheel and axle stores and releases energy
